$comment: Thread 58cb32df (owner 2026-10-23, #EXP-1373, #FEED-140): CHATS. The product says chats, never threads, in every user-facing string ×4 (routes, DB, MCP and code keep `thread`/`session`); threads-list.json `copy.title` and the rail/nav labels read `copy.title` here. PHONE SHELL (iOS, Android, web-mobile; `shell`; #EXP-1379/#EXP-1384 owner 2026-10-24): ONE active team drives every phone screen (no team bands anywhere on a phone: chats, inbox, my issues, the board, search all filter to it); the team is switched ONLY on the Team tab (and silently by a push notification or deep link that names another team: the shell switches first, then opens the target, no prompt). THE BAR = the glass tab capsule (iOS: the app's own glass bar, MobileTabBar; Android + web-mobile: its look-alike on the FAB chrome recipe, fab-chrome.tsx) with `shell.tabs` in order (Board · Chats · Apps · Team), each an icon over its label (`copy.tabs`), the selected one on the glass-active pill; a dot on Chats = chatsUnread. Beside it, unchanged, the two-armed new chat / new issue capsule. `shell.bar`: the capsule is `height` tall with `padding` inside and TAKES THE WIDTH the screen leaves beside the new chat / new issue capsule (`gap` between them; owner 2026-10-24: a label is never cut while there is room); each tab starts as wide as its label (label width + 2 × `tabPaddingX`, at least `tabMinWidth`) and the tabs share the rest of the capsule evenly, so the board name and the team name read whole; a label truncates ONLY when the labels alone do not fit (then the widest gives way first). DRAG (`shell.bar.drag`, the native iOS tab bar's behaviour ×3): a press on the bar lifts the selection LENS (iOS 26: the interactive Liquid Glass `.glassEffect(.regular.interactive())`; iOS 17-25, Android, web: the glass-active pill) under the finger, scaled to `lensScale`; while the finger drags along the bar the lens follows it horizontally (clamped to the bar) and the tab under its centre is the CANDIDATE (its icon and label in the foreground colour); lift = the candidate is selected (the same as tapping it, the Board tab's caret rule included); a lift farther than `cancelDistance` px above or below the bar cancels (the lens springs back to the selected tab); a plain tap selects at once. The lens moves with the finger (no animation while dragging) and settles on lift at `standard` / `decelerate`; reduce motion = no scale. THE BOARD TAB (`shell.boardTab`): its icon = the ACTIVE board's glyph (BoardGlyph: icon + colour; `tabIcons.board` while the team has no board) and its label the board's name (`copy.tabs.board` while none). NOT on the board view: a tap goes to the board, no caret. ON the board view: the label carries the `boardTab.caret` concept (chevrons up-down, `caretSize` px, 2px after the label) after it and a tap (or a drag lifted on it) opens the BOARD MENU. THE BOARD MENU (`shell.boardMenu`, Linear's more menu): the WHOLE bottom strip (the bar and the capsule beside it) MORPHS into one glass context menu panel: the panel grows from the strip's frame (same left, right and bottom edges, corner radius from the strip's to `radius`) over `motion.open` with `motion.openEase`, the strip's content fading out as the rows fade in; it collapses back the reverse way at `motion.close` with `motion.closeEase`. Reduce motion = a plain cross-fade. Its rows = the active team's boards in the sidebar order (no team name, no header), each `rowHeight` tall: the BoardGlyph + the name; the active board on the glass-active pill with the `ui-check` concept trailing; then, for a viewer who may create boards, a muted `copy.boardMenu.newBoard` row (`ui-add`) that opens the New board form. More than `maxVisibleRows` rows scroll inside the panel. A tap on a board switches the board view to it and collapses the menu; a tap outside the panel (a transparent scrim over the page) or the system back collapses it. The top-left board switcher pill of the old board header is GONE ×3 (the board is switched only here); the menu uses each platform's glass menu pieces (iOS GlassMenu, Android GlassMenu.kt, web glass-menu) and the phones' menu look of picker-presentation.json. THE PAGE HEADER (`shell.header`, ×3 on every top-level page `header.pages`: Board, Chats, Apps, Team, Devices, Agent): the large title on the left (`copy.headers.*`; the Board page's title = the board's name, the Team page's = the team's name) and `header.buttons` as round trailing circles: SEARCH (opens the phone search) then the INBOX (concept nav-inbox, a sky dot while any notification of the active team is unread), which pushes the inbox-only page (no segments: My issues and Drafts are on the board). iOS = the large inline navigation title with the NATIVE toolbar circles (plain ToolbarItems, the system's iOS 26 glass circles; never hand-drawn ones); Android + web-mobile = the shared PageHeader (the large in-content headline + the FabButton circles, `header.circle` px). Devices (now a row on the Team page, pushed) wears the same header with the back control before the title. The Board page puts the board chips `shell.boardChips` (All issues · My issues · Drafts; Drafts only while the viewer has drafts; a count after My issues and Drafts) as select Pills under its header; My issues = the viewer's assigned issues of the active team across its boards, grouped by status like the board. THE APPS TAB: the team's Apps list (apps.json THE LIST) as a top-level page under the page header. THE TEAM TAB = the page header (team name), the team avatar (84) + `copy.team.meta`, a glass group of the viewer's teams (the active one checked, a team with an unread notification an amber dot; a tap switches), then the team's settings rows of settings-nav.json `phoneRows` (each opens its OWN page; Devices is the last of them), then the account row (the viewer's avatar) and the rest of the old root. Agent rows leave the Chats list: the agents are the Chats header's BUBBLES. LIST (every form factor: phones, wide web and the IDE paint the SAME list for the active team, #EXP-1380 owner 2026-10-24; `chatList`, `listCases`): the depth-0 rows of partitionThreads(active team) flattened (no bands, no nesting) and sorted by activityAt desc, ties by id. A row = the 52 lead DISC (bg muted) holding the lead (`lead`: needs_you = the brand mark with the amber badge, working = the working mark, else the root's PR glyph open emerald / merged violet, else the bare brand mark; the threadRowMarkState + threadRowLeadPr rules), the title (semibold while unreadCount > 0) and the trailing time (`chatTimeLabel`, `timeCases`: the viewer's local day; today HH:mm, yesterday `copy.time.yesterday`, under 7 days the short weekday, else `Mon D` and `, YYYY` from another year; amber while needsYou, foreground while unread, else muted) on line 1; line 2 = the preview (`chatPreview`, `previewCases`; muted, up to two lines) then the row word (threadRowWord, with its glyph) then the unread badge (unreadCount; amber with black text while needsYou, else foreground with background text; none at 0). Preview rules: the root conversation's own user/agent messages that are plain text or a question / plan / ask / picture / surface card; while needsYou, the newest WAITING question/plan/ask reads `copy.preview.question|plan`; else while busy `copy.preview.working` (italic); else the newest such message: a person's builtin command line = its divider copy, a person's text `copy.preview.you`, a picture `copy.preview.picture`, a surface its title or `copy.preview.surface`, a question/plan as above, an agent's text as is; none = `copy.preview.empty`. Text = `plainLine` (images dropped, links to their text, emphasis/code marks and line prefixes stripped, whitespace collapsed). unreadCount = agent messages of the ROOT conversation (event cards excluded) newer than the viewer's read of the root. Filter chips (`filters`) above the list, select Pills: All, Needs you, Running, Unread, labelled by `chatFilterLabel` (a count after a non-zero one); a chip filters by the row's group (needs_you / running) or unreadCount > 0. A row hairline (glass-stroke) runs under the text column only. BUBBLES (`agentBubbles`, `bubbleCases`): listAgents(active team) in order, a 66 circle each (the agent's icon in its colour on bg muted inside a 3px background gap) with the name under it; ring = amber while the viewer's conversation needs them, foreground while it has an agent message newer than their read, else a glass-stroke hairline; a tap opens the agent's chat, a long-press its agent menu. The row scrolls sideways. WIDE (web wide + the IDE): the Chats page = the bubbles row, the filter chips, then the rows, one column at the page's list width (the old Needs you · Running · Recent bands leave the page; the rail keeps its own rows). LIST DATA ×4 (owner 2026-10-24: "everyone should use the same digest"): the list, the bubbles' rings, the rail's chat rows and the titles never read a transcript: they read each conversation's server-kept DIGEST (`conversations.digest`, synced with the conversations shape; `conversationDigest`, the same rules over the same messages) turned back into messages by `digestMessages` (`digestCases`: null = none; first, preview, waiting once each by id; one bodiless agent message `digest:<sessionId>:<index>` per `agentTimes` entry, except one per instant (compared as instants, a multiset) already stood for by a kept non-event agent message; then, when `agentAt`, one `event` card agent message `digest:<sessionId>:agent`), and the unchanged list rules run over them. A chat's messages load when it opens; the transcript, unread marking and pickup stay on messages. MENUS ×4 (`threadMenuEntries`, `menuCases`; `agentMenuEntries`, `agentMenuCases`): a chat row (phone list, web/IDE Chats page rows, the rail's chat rows) opens its menu by right-click on pointers and by long-press on touch, through each platform's ONE menu host (web menu.tsx `menuProps('thread', id)` + MenuGestureHost, desktop PointerContextMenu, iOS GlassLongPressMenu, Android combinedClickable + the glass menu sheet); phones present it as the sheet look with the chat's title as its header. Live root → Stop (coding-stop) and Stop and delete (ui-delete, destructive); ended root → Delete (destructive); the delete entries (Stop and delete, Delete) need `canDelete` = the viewer started the chat or is a team owner (the server's sessions.delete rule), so a viewer who can steer but not delete gets Stop alone on a live chat and nothing on an ended one; a viewer who cannot steer the chat, or whose entries come out empty, gets no menu. The chat's header `...` menu holds the same entries. Stop = `sessions.end` on the root (the whole tree ends, deepest first; a later message still resumes the root, FEED-134); Stop and delete = `sessions.delete` (the server ends what is live, then deletes); Delete = `sessions.delete`. Delete asks first ×4: `copy.confirmDelete` (title, body, destructive confirm = `copy.menu.delete`). After a delete the chat's screen closes back to the list. A failure = a toast (`copy.toasts.*`). The agent menu (the agent chat's header `...`, a bubble's long-press, the rail's agent row right-click): Compact conversation, New conversation, Stop while busy (= `sessions.stop`, the TURN interrupt), Agent settings for team owners; Compact and New conversation SEND the builtin lines `agentMenu.sends` (one path with the typed `/compact` and `/new`). STOP (FEED-134 follow-up): a thread's header Stop pill = the menu's Stop (ends the tree; shown while the root is not ended); the composer's stop button (while busy, empty input) = `sessions.stop`, the turn interrupt; an agent chat has no Stop pill, only the composer button and the menu's Stop. `sessions.stop` returns `delivered` (false when the relay reached no device for a live, non-queued session) and a false one toasts `copy.toasts.stopNotDelivered`. TRANSCRIPT ×4 (session-thread.json buildSessionThread rows): a person's message whose body is exactly `/new`, or `/compact` alone or followed by a space, is a `divider` row {kind new|compact}, painted as the centred glass pill `copy.dividers.<kind> · HH:mm` (icon ui-clean / coding-compact), never a bubble. Phones paint the conversation as CHAT BUBBLES: the person's on the right (UserMessageBubble, max 80%), the agent's text on the left in a bg-card bubble (max 94%, top-left corner 6px, its time bottom-right), cards inside the agent column; web wide and the IDE keep their transcript. A WAITING plan or question card (FEED-140) is ALWAYS visible inline at its place in the conversation with its actions (Approve / answer), on every platform, besides the dock; a second `plan` from the agent while one waits SUPERSEDES the waiting one (the old card resolves with decision `superseded` and paints collapsed as `copy.superseded`), it is never refused. SURFACE CARD ×4 (`surfaceCard`): message card kind `surface` {surface: {root, data}, title?} = an agent's inline Exponential UI preview, posted by MCP `exponential_session_self {op: "show", surface, title?}` (validated like a plan card's surface: the core catalog, `surfaceMaxBytes`, `surfaceMaxComponents`), painted inside the agent's bubble/column by the platform's renderer exactly like the plan card's surface (theme exponential, dark), max width the column, its own rounded glass frame. It answers nothing: a press whose action event is named `replyEvent` with a non-empty `context.text` posts that text as the person's next message (`surfaceReply`, `replyCases`); every other event is ignored. ENTER (owner 2026-10-23: "it should animate into the view, very elegant"; `surfaceCard.enter`, motion tokens only): a surface card that ARRIVES while its chat is open (its id was not in the transcript the screen first painted; history, a reopen or a scroll never animates) plays once: the frame fades in from `frame.fromOpacity`, rises from `fromTranslateY` px and scales from `fromScale` over `frame.duration` with `frame.ease`; its hairline starts at the primary colour at `glow.fromOpacity` and settles to the normal stroke over `glow.duration`; after `children.startAfterMs` the surface ROOT's first-level children enter one by one (opacity + `fromTranslateY` px rise at `children.duration`, `staggerMs` apart, children past `maxStaggered` share the last delay). Under reduce motion: a plain opacity fade of the frame, no rise, scale, glow or stagger. Phones also bring every NEW bubble in (live arrival only) with an opacity + 6px rise at `standard` / `decelerate`. WINDOW ×4 (`transcript`, #EXP-1380; review of #1218): a chat (thread or agent) paints its NEWEST `transcript.window` rows, and the window's START reaches up to the oldest WAITING plan / question / ask card when that card is older (a waiting card is never cut off, so it stays inline at its place); a `Load earlier` ghost button above them moves the start up by `transcript.windowStep` in ONE press (the run view's look, the reader's scroll position kept). Once painted the start is PINNED: new arrivals append below it whether the reader follows the tail or has scrolled up, so the window only grows and never re-slides; reopening the chat starts again at the newest window. The start = `transcriptWindowStart` (`windowCases`): tail = max(0, rowCount - window); base = the pinned start (the first paint's start, min the tail) or the tail before the first paint; base = min(base, every waiting card's index); start = max(0, base - loadedSteps × windowStep). WORKING: while the chat's session works, the transcript ends on the run view's ONE status line (the working mark + `Working…` / the turn caption), agent chats included. FOLLOW + JUMP ×4 (#EXP-1383): the transcript follows the tail while the reader is within `transcript.followSlack` px of the bottom; scrolled further up, THE JumpToBottomButton (the arrow-only glass circle, 12px above the composer / dock) shows on every chat, phone bubble layouts included, EXACTLY the session run view's (owner 2026-10-24: "exactly as in sessions": the same component, size, fill, icon and placement above the composer / dock on each platform; the run view reads the same `followSlack`); a tap scrolls to the newest row and resumes following. Opening a chat lands on the newest row. PERF ×4: rows render once per change of their own message (memoized / lazily laid out), the clock ticks only while a session of the chat is live, and the markdown editor never mounts per row (the run view's cheap text path). Mirrors: TS src/chats.ts (the reference), iOS ExpCore Chats.swift, Android domain/Chats.kt replay every case group; desktop domain::chats replays every group too (previewCases, timeCases, listCases, bubbleCases, menuCases, agentMenuCases, replyCases, dividerCases, plainCases, windowCases, digestCases).

agentHint.$comment: #EXP-1383: INSTRUCTIONS CHANGED. An agent's instructions reach its conversation once per engine launch: the device fetches `sessions.brief`, which stamps `sessions.agent_instructions_at` = now on the fetching session. `agents.update` stamps `agents.instructions_updated_at` = now ONLY when the instructions TEXT changes (a rename, a trigger toggle or a device pick never does); `agents.create` stamps it too. `agentInstructionsChanged({sessionStamp, agentStamp})` (TS reference packages/domain-contract/src/chats.ts; mirrors desktop domain::chats, iOS Chats.swift, Android Chats.kt) replays `cases`: true iff BOTH stamps are set and sessionStamp < agentStamp (equal = current; a session that never fetched a brief or an agent never stamped = false). Read on an agent chat's ROOT session only (`sessions.agent_id` set, depth 0) against its agent row. While true the chat's Dock carries ONE more banner row (dock.json: kind `banner`, NO new component) `banner` = {id, icon concept, label, text, tone, action}; its action word sends `sends` exactly like the agent menu's New conversation (`agentMenu.sends.newConversation`) and the row stays until the fresh launch re-fetches the brief (the shape update hides it). On an AGENT chat `/new` RESTARTS the engine (the CLI process ends, a fresh launch re-fetches the brief, so the new instructions apply) instead of the in-process clear (claude `/clear`, codex `thread/start`); the transcript keeps its `dividers.new` divider either way. Normal threads keep the in-process `/new`.
